note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Maiti (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; the alate section is marked 'After Hill, 1942'; the soldier measurements are in table 51 of the original and no figures are given in the main text, so the soldier section has no measurements.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate compound eyes very large (0.36 x 0.36 mm), ocelli rather large (length 0.14 mm), broadly oval, fontanelle small, spherical, with a shallow groove running from the fontanelle to the postclypeus; soldier head straw yellow, longer than wide, antennae 13-segmented, labrum length slightly more than a quarter of its basal width.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale brown, sparsely hairy, paler anteriorly; labrum, legs and venter dull yellow; pronotum and wing buds slightly darker than the legs. Compound eyes very large (0.36 x 0.36 mm), ocelli rather large (length 0.14 mm), broadly oval. Fontanelle small, spherical, with a shallow groove running from the fontanelle to the postclypeus. Postclypeus length slightly more than a third of its width. Antennae: segment 2 shorter than half of segment 1, only slightly longer than segment 3. Pronotum flat, narrower than the head, much wider than long, anterior margin arcuate, anterior lateral angles and sides rounded; posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum broadly arcuate. Measurements (mm): head to labral apex 1.06; head to clypeofrontal suture 0.80; head width 1.10; pronotum length 0.47; pronotum width 0.88.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head straw yellow, longer than wide, sides slightly rounded and slightly narrowed anteriorly, widest between the fontanelle and the posterior margin. Labrum length slightly more than a quarter of its basal width, reaching almost the mandible apex. Fontanelle small, round, very distinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 shorter than segment 3 or 4. Left mandible: apical tooth opposite the teeth of the right mandible. Pronotum anterior margin convex, weakly concave in the middle; posterior margin less convex, without a median notch. Head and thorax sparsely covered with long hairs. (Soldier measurements in table 51 of the original.)
